source.behavior: Validate each file; upload eligible files to the selected WordPress site; single-file metadata only; report progress and per-file results, with failure and rejected outcomes.

laravel_runtime.upload_strategy: Bounded 20 files; per-file POST validated and stored in tenant+site-scoped path; WordPress REST upload queued; local ContentTransfer result read provides authoritative completed/failed/unknown, never 202-as-success
laravel_runtime.metadata_scope: Title/alt text/caption only when exactly one file selected

security.site_scope: server-derived TenantContext and tenant-scoped Site query
security.cross_tenant: foreign tenant/site routes fail closed with 404
security.validation: 25 MiB limit, allowed file extensions and matching server-detected media types
security.provider_boundary: WordPress upload job is single-attempt to prevent ambiguous POST replay; WordPress success requires job and sync confirmation

proofs: canonical operation and source UI binding
duplicate-submit prevention and truthful queued status
single-file metadata and transfer status reread
failed selection retained and invalid rejected
no WordPress success claimed for HTTP 202

provenance.test_execution: Previous CI: 1957 PHPUnit pass, one focused route-auth assertion failed; explicit auth middleware fixed in e03a650. Latest exact-head CI must pass before merge.
